citations.cites: Exclusion E-61 – water damage from burst supply line while unoccupied >30 days, exception if water shut off and drained
Clause 4 – landlord must inspect within 7 days; failure voids exception in E-61

facts: Tenant left on 1 September; landlord had plumber shut off water at the main and drain the system on 3 September.
No inspection of the unit was done after the tenant left.
On 20 October, water was reported under the door due to a burst supply line fitting; estimate $11,200.
note: Exclusion E-61 excludes water damage from a burst supply line when the dwelling is unoccupied between tenancies for more than 30 days, but its exception is voided because the landlord failed to inspect within 7 days as required by Clause 4. The adjuster should consider this exclusion. [DP-0703_02-24#05] [DP-0703_02-24#06]
